BiblicalUsage: The word means strife or contention, and Isaiah uses it once, of the enemies who contend with God's servant: they shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the promise is complete: those who strive against God's people do not merely lose, they come to nothing, because the fight was never really against us.
